notes.title: Version 1.1.20
notes.content:
Version 1.1.20

- No longer possible to get -1 Upgrade Points
- Juni now reacts correctly to all the variants of players actions from Hexport when you see her a second time
- Bliss now helps players get started with repairs
- Players can no longer both Fail and Succeed on the Hidden Wreck Contract

notes.title: Shoot for the stars with Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/2b396e533dc98013d0ca42eb88d631ca3cfbcada.png[/img]

For those who seek to venture deeper into the world of Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, we’re pleased to announce that the Deluxe Edition of the game will be available on Steam from launch.

The Deluxe Edition includes:

[list]
[*]The full game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442460/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector/]Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector[/url][/b]

[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415120/Citizen_Sleeper_2__The_Sleepers_Sketchbook/]The Sleeper’s Sketchbook[/url][/b], a 45-page companion piece collecting character sketches by Guillaume Singelin for Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector

[*] The game’s [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398420/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector_Soundtrack/]original soundtrack[/url][/b] consisting of 34 tracks by Amos Roddy, the composer of Citizen Sleeper and In Other Waters.
[/list]

[h3]The Deluxe Edition of Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector collects all of these items at 10% off![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442460/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector/

notes.title: Grab the first Citizen Sleeper game for 40% off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/ef450b88485be32685b5b0a7837273c23bccae66.png[/img]

[h3]The annual Fellow Traveller [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]Publisher Sale[/url] is now on - and to celebrate, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578650/Citizen_Sleeper/]first Citizen Sleeper game[/url] is 40% off. With the sequel on the way, now's the perfect time to pick it up![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578650/Citizen_Sleeper

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023][b]➡️ Take me to the Publisher Sale ⬅️[/b][/url]

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

[h3]We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; [b]Scrabdackle[/b], [b]Wander Stars[/b] and [b]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/b] - read up on each of them below![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575810/Wander_Stars/]Wander Stars[/url]:[/b] Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/]Scrabdackle[/url]:[/b] As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2246470/Kulebra_and_the_Souls_of_Limbo/]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/url]:[/b] A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.[/list]So get exploring and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]grab some great narrative games[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238001/08bd399b820db34ab9715984ebab19df7c24f4b9.png[/img]

Players looking to say up to date with Citizen Sleeper and its upcoming sequel should sign-up for the [url=https://citizensleeper.com/Helion-Dispatches]Citizen Sleeper newsletter[/url] - not only will you get updates on the games and other things like merch, but you'll also receive the [b]Helion Dispatches[/b], a monthly series of text-based narrative transmissions from the refugee ship, the Pilgrim Seed, which flesh out the wider lore of Citizen Sleeper, set up the narrative for the sequel and bridge the gap between the two games.

Make sure to wishlist Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442460/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector/

And remember to stay up to date with all the latest Citizen Sleeper news here:
